test_policy: NOT_USED: no Test prediction, metric or analysis in this round

arm_a.role: FIXED1 / CSC v0 mollipo A, read-only reuse (no retraining)
arm_a.init_rule: BM.build_model(scale=1, seed=0) base init + zeroed stage-2 fc; reproduced base_state_sha256 recorded in the run

arm_b.head: BSModel.post_local (literal call) with f, rho, 4-head attention readout and global buffers
arm_b.head_init: identical to A's recorded initialisation (verified by fingerprint)
arm_b.encoder_init: torch.manual_seed(0) inside fork_rng, default PyTorch init
arm_b.init_pairing_claim: none for the encoder; different architectures cannot be parameter-matched
arm_b.depth_rule: reuse hidden=128; take the largest L in {5,4,3,...} whose total parameters fall in A +/-15%; L=5 exceeds, L=4 fits; frozen before training

shared_raw_inputs.note: Same OGB raw attribute table and same real graph as A; A additionally derives S1/S2 local content (2-hop path statistics, incident bond-class fractions), B does not. This is a matched-budget encoder-level comparison, not a single-operator ablation.

recipe.selection: minimum full official Valid RMSE; strictly smaller replaces, ties keep the earlier epoch

analysis.diagnostic_thresholds: Train medians, fixed before analysis; atom signature = (atomic_num, degree, min_ring), rarity = -log Train frequency

verdict.rule: ENCODER_ADVANTAGE_SIGNAL iff (RMSE_B - RMSE_A)/RMSE_A <= -0.02 on Valid best checkpoint AND paired molecule-bootstrap 95% CI of the RMSE difference is entirely below 0; NO_CLEAR_ENCODER_ADVANTAGE if |rel| < 2% or CI contains 0; INCONCLUSIVE if the comparison is not supported; REFERENCE_NOT_COMPARABLE if any comparability condition fails

comparability_conditions: same official split and molecule set
both encoders consume only the same raw OGB atom/bond table and the same real graph
one literal post_local implementation and initialisation
